content.title: Fox Sets the Tone as Red Lions Edge Blue Sharks in Extra Time
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that kept swinging from start to finish. Fox put Red Lions ahead in the 28th minute, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd, Reid restored the lead in the 95th, Cruz made it 2-2 in the 105th, and Bell’s own goal in the 113th put Red Lions back in front before the match reached 120+1'.

Red Lions had the stronger grip on the game overall, with 85 final-third actions out of every 100, 69 possession out of every 100, and 776 completed passes from 838 attempts. Blue Sharks stayed in touch, but Red Lions carried more of the play, especially in the closing stretch, when they had 91 of the final-third actions and 79 of the possession over the last 10 minutes.

Fox was once again central for Red Lions, with a goal, 6 shots, 140 touches, and a yellow card. The captain’s early strike set the tone, and Red Lions kept finding ways to stay on top in a chaotic extra-time finish.
